content.summary: Skeptical author review accepts a catalog-bound official-example registry and conditional factor reasoning. The real FAQ supplies two branches of one example, not two independent court cases. Outcome means paragraph 3.11 applicability, not an unconditional prohibition. Unknown edition history remains a question.
findings: Fourteen focused registry and assurance-integration tests passed; wrong jurisdiction/issuer/issue/date, invented court classification, bad anchors and unknown factors are refused or explicitly excluded.
Original complete FAQ bytes and exact target/source quotations are retained. Both actual branches remain one evidence family with proposed factor materiality.

Registered examples use a separate source-bound query task. Legacy model-supplied case records are explicitly unregistered hypothetical proposals and cannot gain official identity from their own label.
Registry changes invalidate affected issue dependencies; unrelated example issues do not. Failed or absent comparisons remain unresolved and cannot prune candidates.
